speedup_source: mean of 6 real, diverse (event,Lambda) baseline runs -- profile_pipeline.py + profile_supplement.py -- validated bit-identical output (comparisons/VALIDATION_SUMMARY.json)

caveat: This is still an ESTIMATE, not a re-measurement of the full 91-point grid (which was not launched). It rescales the previously-verified 425h downstream estimate by a speedup factor measured on 6 representative (not all 91) points. The speedup was highly consistent across all 6 (14.09x-19.57x, no systematic dependence on benchmark/boost-class/Lambda observed), supporting extrapolation, but this is not a substitute for measuring the full grid directly.
